title: Astrid and the Verdict
author: Paloma Zhou
blurb: Isandro Sterling, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
